_readme: Project criteria chosen by the engineer. These are not code values. The engineer may change them per project.

cantileverDeflectionMultiplier.note: Cantilever tip deflection is checked against (multiplier x cantilever length) / limit. Baher decision 2026-11-23.

defaultBearingLength.note: Used only when the supporting element's size is unknown. Marked assumed. Baher decision 2026-11-23.

postEffectiveLengthFactorKe.note: Posts pinned at both ends. Baher decision 2026-11-23.

maxSpansForPatternLoading.note: Every on/off span pattern is run up to this many spans (2^n cases). Above it the engine stops and warns. Baher decision 2026-11-23.
